scope: Additive v4 revision of all 18 prompts and complete option/diagnostic sets: removes the answer rule from the stem and uses case-local competing retry policies with their consequences. Keeps all question IDs, accepted option IDs and the existing three wrong-option identities because their underlying misconceptions are unchanged.

items.learningObjective: Choose a retry identity that resolves one operation’s uncertain outcome without merging a distinct later operation.
items.decisiveFact: On a public-transit disruption board, each platform change has a stable change ID and effective sequence. A controller can lose its acknowledgement after submitting a change, and another change to that same platform may be valid later. Which policy should govern a retry?
items.nearestAlternative: Give each attempt a fresh ID; a lost reply can publish the same platform change twice.
items.identityReason: The unit decision remains retry identity for one uncertain operation. The same-ID answer meaning and each wrong policy (new ID per attempt, overbroad resource key, or treating a lost acknowledgement as rejection) are preserved, so existing question and option identities remain valid.
